rules.message: Service 'delivery-service' calls a third party inline with no queue or workflow engine to fall back to when that call fails.
Database 'orders-db' relies on async read replicas as its only scaling above 5000 rps. Replicas do not scale writes.
Edge 'bff' -> 'order-service' retries without a circuit breaker, and 'order-service' has no rate limiter in front of it. Retry storms will cascade.
Database 'orders-db' is a single unsharded writer declared at more than 5000 rps. Shard it or move to a multi-writer distributed store.
Stateful node 'legacy-monolith' lives in exactly one availability zone. A zone outage takes its state with it.
Stream processor 'event-processor' windows by event time but declares no watermark. Late data handling is undefined.
Cache 'session-cache' has no eviction policy. Declare lru, lfu or ttl, or justify none explicitly.
Datastore 'catalog-db' has no backup or no retention policy declared.
Datastore 'catalog-db' is single-region with no replication, but the design requires multi-region availability.
Store 'metadata-db' is multi-leader across regions with no conflict resolution policy. Declare last-writer-wins, vector-clock or app-merge.
Object store 'data-nodes-hot' spans fewer than 3 zones (or declares none) while the design targets more than 10 nines of durability.
Datastore 'metadata-db' serves a read-heavy workload directly from application servers and the design has no cache.
Shared dependency 'edge-dns' is not redundant, but the design requires redundant discovery.
Shared dependency 'placement' is not redundant, but the design requires redundant discovery.
'placement' is pinned to a single availability zone with no failover or replication.
Topic 'order-events' cannot replay messages, but the design requires replay. Use a stream or a replayable queue.
Queue 'orders-queue' receives async traffic but has no dead-letter queue.
Entry point 'api' starts a synchronous call chain deeper than 3 hops while the design states a p95 latency target.
Design 'payment-system' holds data but declares no credential rotation period and has no key-management node.

Edge 'payment-service' -> 'payment-executor' claims exactly-once delivery, but 'payment-executor' calls a third party synchronously. Exactly-once cannot cover that side effect; make the external call idempotent instead.
Edge 'payment-executor' -> 'psp' moves money but does not declare idempotent, while the design requires exactly-once effect. Add an idempotency key to this hop.
Design 'payment-system' requires zero-sum money movement but has no ledger node. Record money in an append-only double-entry ledger.
Queue 'retry-queue' receives async traffic but has no dead-letter queue.
Retry queue 'retry-queue' has no dead-letter queue. Messages that keep failing must be parked for manual investigation.
Retry queue 'retry-queue' declares no backoff. Retries without backoff amplify the outage they are retrying through.
Webhook 'psp-webhook' does not verify signatures or is not idempotent. Verify the caller's signature and deduplicate by event id.
Synchronous edge 'admin-server-a' -> 'channel-server-b' crosses a cell boundary while the design requires cell isolation.
Realtime gateway 'gateway-server-a' calls a coordination service synchronously on connect but has no reconnect stampede guard.
Realtime gateway 'gateway-server-a' assigns channels randomly while the design declares heavy-tail traffic. Hot channels will degrade unrelated tenants on the same host.
Worker 'job-workers' consumes more than one queue while the design requires per-queue isolation. Give each queue its own worker pool.
Service 'channel-server-a' is on a consistent hash ring but is not connected to a coordination service that manages the ring.
Service 'channel-server-b' is on a consistent hash ring but is not connected to a coordination service that manages the ring.
Realtime gateway 'gateway-server-a' autoscales but does not drain connections on scale-in. Every scale-down becomes a reconnect storm.
Database 'tweet-store' is written by application servers and the design has a search index, but no change-data-capture propagates its updates. Index writes rely on dual writes.
Cache 'home-timeline-cache' is the primary store for its data but has persistence disabled.
Search index 'search-index' has no asynchronous feed from a stream, change data capture or worker. It cannot be rebuilt or kept in sync independently of the write path.
Service 'write-api' calls a worker synchronously. Hand the job to a queue or stream so the request path does not wait for fan-out.
Cache 'home-timeline-cache' holds materialised data but nothing durable or no worker feeds it. It cannot be rebuilt after loss.
Worker 'fanout-daemon' pushes fan-out over a social graph with no fanoutThreshold. Declare a follower threshold above which timelines are merged at read time.
